findings.summary: Delta path derives the changed-module set from staged paths only, so a module made non-compliant by an unstaged or already-committed edit outside the delta is not re-checked until something in it is staged again.
findings.failure_scenario: A module drifts out of compliance via a change that never appears in a later staged delta; check-module.sh reports ok on every subsequent commit and the violation ships. Non-blocking: the full-tree path still catches it when invoked, and M0.5 scopes the delta path as an optimisation.
